info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Agents Tags API
Amazon Application Discovery Service Create Tags

items.docs: Creates one or more tags for configuration items. Tags are metadata that help you categorize IT assets.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Delete Tags

items.docs: Deletes the association between configuration items and one or more tags. This API accepts a list of multiple configuration items.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Describe Tags

items.docs: Retrieves a list of configuration items that have tags as specified by the key-value pairs, name and value, passed to the optional parameter filters.
